typedef void(*) ui_session_draw_fn(frame_buffer_t *output, terminal_size_t size, const animation_sample_t *animation, void *context)

A borrowed view, valid for the duration of ui_session_render(). Hosts retain snapshots and serialize access to a session; callbacks must not recurse into its renderer. The runtime owns selection policy, transitions and animation.
